refreshDuringMove.name: Refresh During Movement
refreshDuringMove.hint: If disabled, aura highlights will only refresh when a token stops moving or its settings are updated. This can improve performance.

thickness.name: Highlight Thickness
thickness.hint: The thickness of the aura highlights in pixels (1-100).

radius.name: Aura Radius
radius.hint: The radius of the aura in scene distance units.
